verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cal.com exposes scheduling to external AI clients through a hosted MCP server, an agent-oriented API and a CLI. These let outside agents act on Cal.com data. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions produced inside the product itself. An 'Insights' feature is mentioned only as an EE-only feature removed from Cal.diy, with no indication it is AI-generated, and the routing trace is deterministic logic, not AI analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
